regions.today: Dry and sunny with cloud developing this evening. Light winds.
regions.tonight: Cloud increasing but it will remain dry. Light southerly breezes and rather humid conditions overnight too with lowest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Overcast and misty to start, but sunny spells will break through by the afternoon with isolated showers possible in the evening. Warm and humid with highs of 20 to 23 degrees in just light southwesterly breezes.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate Monday, low to moderate on Tuesday.
